replacements.Texto, imagen, audio y documentos no tie: Text, image, audio, and documents do not have naturally equivalent units. Correspondences across modalities are learned incompletely and are biased by the available data.
replacements.En audio y vídeo el orden forma parte de: In audio and video, order is part of meaning: rhythm, interruption, change of tone. These are not "more tokens" but synchrony and conversational context that the model must preserve.
replacements.Una respuesta estadísticamente plausible: A statistically plausible answer can be poorly supported by the perceptual signal. OCRBench v2 and MMAU expose this limitation systematically in documents and audio.
replacements.La aspiración es any-to-any. El estado r: The aspiration is any-to-any. The actual state in 2026: strong in embeddings and visual description, variable in generation, limited in expert audio, uneven in video.
